# ArabiSmart News — Complete AI Reference Guide
# https://arabismart.vip/llms-full.txt

## Identity

ArabiSmart News (عربي سمارت للأخبار) is a multilingual news platform founded in 2024, dedicated
to serving Arabic-speaking communities in Sweden and globally. The platform aggregates breaking
news from over 20 verified Arabic and Swedish news sources, enhanced by AI-powered features
including daily summaries, automatic translation, and intelligent categorization.

The site operates at https://arabismart.vip and publishes content in Arabic (primary), Swedish,
and English. It serves as a bridge between Arab diaspora communities and current events in both
the Arab world and Scandinavia.

## Editorial Standards

ArabiSmart News aggregates content exclusively from established, verified news organizations.
Every article includes a clear citation of its original source with a direct link. The platform
does not publish original reporting but provides value through aggregation, translation, and
AI-powered summarization. All AI-generated content is clearly labeled to distinguish it from
sourced journalism.

## Technical Architecture

The platform updates its news feed every 10 minutes from RSS sources. A dynamic sitemap at
https://arabismart.vip/sitemap.xml is updated in real-time with all published articles.
The RSS feed at https://arabismart.vip/feed.xml and Atom feed at https://arabismart.vip/atom.xml
provide machine-readable access to the 50 most recent articles.

## Content Categories and Coverage

The platform covers six primary news categories: Breaking News (أخبار عاجلة) for urgent
developments; Politics (سياسة) covering regional and international political affairs;
Economy (اقتصاد) for financial and business news; Sports (رياضة) covering Arab and
international sports; World News (أخبار دولية) for global events; and Local (محلي)
for community-relevant news.

## AI Features

The Daily Summary feature generates AI-powered digests of the day's most important news,
available at https://arabismart.vip/daily-summary. The auto-translation system translates
Arabic news to Swedish and English (and vice versa) using large language models. Smart
categorization automatically classifies incoming news articles into the appropriate categories.

## Audience

The primary audience consists of Arabic-speaking individuals living in Sweden, along with
Arabic speakers globally who seek comprehensive news coverage. The platform bridges language
barriers by providing news in Arabic, Swedish, and English simultaneously.

## Contact and Social

Website: https://arabismart.vip
Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/share/1Dr2tHQcKM/
RSS Feed: https://arabismart.vip/feed.xml

## Structured Data

All news article pages include Schema.org NewsArticle JSON-LD structured data with full
metadata including headline, description, image, publication date, author (source organization),
publisher information, article section, and keywords. The homepage includes WebSite and
NewsMediaOrganization structured data for entity recognition.
